name: Yin Yue Chenxing zhi Ke
source:
A fan-made R18 SakaGin (Sakamoto x Gintoki) game made out of love, a birthday tribute to Sakamoto Tatsuma. It's a visual novel, very small in size. The right to interpret copyright belongs to the original work Gintama.

[MTL of description from [url=https://dongleng.itch.io/yinyue-chenxing-zhike]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
粉丝制作的R18 SakaGin（坂本x银时）游戏，出于爱而制作，是向坂本辰马的生日致敬。这是一部视觉小说，尺寸很小。版权解释权归银魂原创作品所有。

[来自[url=https://dongleng.itch.io/yinyue-chenxing-zhike]Itch.io[/url]的描述]
